title: SB1128 (2026 Regular Session): Enacts provisions relating to firearm privacy

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 314.405 (RSMo): 3. Except for those records kept during the regular course of a criminal investigation and prosecution, or as otherwise required by law, no government entity or official and no agent or employee of a government entity shall knowingly keep or cause to be kept any list, record, or registry of privately owned firearms or the owners of those firearms.
Section 314.405 (RSMo): 4. No payment card network shall require or incentivize the use of a merchant category code in a manner that distinguishes a firearm retailer from other retailers.
Section 314.405 (RSMo): 5. No covered entity shall assign a firearm retailer a merchant category code that distinguishes the firearm retailer from other retailers.
Section 314.405 (RSMo): 6. The attorney general shall investigate reasonable allegations that a person or entity, including a government entity, has violated the provisions of this section and, upon finding a violation, provide written notice to the person or entity believed to have committed the violation.
